stem: Which of the following best characterizes the Gilded Age?

options.label: A
options.text: The discovery of goldfields in the West led to an increase in the amount of money issued for circulation.

options.label: B
options.text: Industrialists used their connections with corrupt government officials for material gain and political power.

options.label: C
options.text: In the Deep South a sharp increase in immigration brought a boom in construction and industry.

options.label: D
options.text: Small, family-owned farms were bought and consolidated to form large agricultural corporations.
